Lumia landing page hero - three structural directions

Low-fidelity wireframes focused on hierarchy, CTA placement, and where proof or product context enters the page.

A

Split narrative

Headline and CTA stay on the left, while a workspace preview carries the product story on the right. This stays closest to the current Lumia direction.

B

Centered announcement

The hero opens with a centered message and tight CTA cluster, then moves directly into a full-width product strip below. This makes the page feel more campaign-like and editorial.

C

Proof-first asymmetric

A narrow proof rail appears before the main message, so trust signals and launch outcomes frame the value prop before the product preview takes over.

Open the local visual companion and compare which structure feels strongest for Lumia. Then come back to chat and tell me A, B, or C.
